title: Ian Crafford, Editor of ‘Hope and Glory,’ ‘Field of Dreams,’ Dies at 82
content:
ByPat Saperstein

Deputy Editor

Ian Crafford, who edited notable films including John Boorman’s “Hope and Glory” and “Field of Dreams,” died July 22 of cancer at his home in Brazil. He was 82.

Born in Hemel Hempstead, U.K., Crafford started working at Elstree Studios at the age of 17 and enjoyed it so much he never returned to school, according to his son Scott.

He went on to become the youngest first assistant editor in England, working with editors such as the renowned Ann Coates. He worked in several departments including sound, ADR (Sophia Loren requested him to do her ADR, his son noted), and worked on sound effects for “Monty Python’s Holy Grail” in 1975.

One of his first credits as editor was working with Richard Burton on “Medusa Touch.” He went on to serve as editor for the James Bond film “Never Say Never Again,” directed by Irvin Kershner, in 1983. In 1985, he traveled with Boorman to Brazil for the production of “Emerald Forest,” and fell in love with the country to which he later retired.

Crafford received a BAFTA nomination for editing Boorman’s next film “Hope and Glory,” about a young boy living in London during the WWII bombings. He moved to America, where he edited the Kevin Costner-starring “Field of Dreams,” for which he received an ACE Eddie nomination, the book adaptation “The Indian in the Cupboard,” “Thunderheart” and “Class Action.”

His last film was the 2012 comedy “The Hot Potato.”

He is survived by his wife Antonia and his four children Scott, Roberta, Monyka and Paul.
title_zh: 《希望與榮耀》(Hope and Glory) 和《夢想田野》(Field of Dreams) 的剪輯師伊恩·克拉福德(Ian Crafford)於82歲時去世。
content_zh:
由帕特·薩珀斯坦(ByPat Saperstein)

副編輯

伊恩·克拉福德(Ian Crafford)，編輯過包括約翰·布爾曼(John Boorman)的《希望與榮耀》(Hope and Glory)和《夢田》(Field of Dreams)等著名影片，於7月22日在巴西的家中因癌症去世，享年82歲。

克拉福德出生於英國赫梅爾亨普斯特德(Hemel Hempstead)，根據他的兒子斯科特(Scott)的說法，他在17歲時開始在艾爾斯特里影業(Elstree Studios)工作，並因為非常喜歡這份工作而從未回到學校。

他成為英國最年輕的首席助理編輯，與著名的安·科茨(Ann Coates)等編輯合作。他在多個部門工作，包括音效、ADR（他的兒子提到索菲亞·羅蘭(Sophia Loren)曾要求他為她進行ADR），並在1975年為《蒙提·派森的聖杯》(Monty Python’s Holy Grail)製作音效。

他作為編輯的第一部作品之一是與理查德·伯頓(Richard Burton)合作的《美杜莎之觸》(Medusa Touch)。1983年，他擔任伊爾文·柯許納(Irvin Kershner)執導的詹姆斯·邦德電影《永不言死》(Never Say Never Again)的編輯。1985年，他隨著布爾曼前往巴西製作《翡翠森林》(Emerald Forest)，並愛上了這個國家，最終在此退休。

克拉福德因編輯布爾曼的下一部電影《希望與榮耀》而獲得BAFTA提名，該片講述了一名在二戰轟炸期間生活在倫敦的小男孩。他移居美國，編輯了凱文·科斯特納(Kevin Costner)主演的《夢田》，並因此獲得ACE艾迪提名，還編輯了改編自書籍的《櫃子裡的印第安人》(The Indian in the Cupboard)、《雷霆之心》(Thunderheart)和《集體訴訟》(Class Action)。

他的最後一部電影是2012年的喜劇《熱馬鈴薯》(The Hot Potato)。

他留下了妻子安東尼亞(Antonia)和四個孩子斯科特(Scott)、羅伯塔(Roberta)、莫尼卡(Monyka)和保羅(Paul)。
